missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Дыхание' is the neuter nominative subject of 'было'. 'Спокойным' is the instrumental predicate adjective common after the past tense of быть.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Дыхание' is the inanimate neuter accusative object of 'слушал', identical to the nominative. 'Пациента' is the genitive of possession.
Strategic focus: Genitive of negation. 'Дыхания' takes the genitive after the negative 'не было' to express absence. 'У старика' marks the possessor in the genitive.
Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'Благодаря дыханию' uses the dative after 'благодаря' to show the cause. 'Успокоился' is the reflexive past verb.

missions.phrase: Она следит за дыханием во сне.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Instrumental after preposition. 'За дыханием' uses the instrumental after 'за' with 'следить' to mean monitoring. 'Во сне' shows the circumstance.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'В дыхании' uses the prepositional after 'в' to locate the perceived quality. 'Усталость' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Дыхание' is the nominative subject of 'стало'. 'Быстрым' is the instrumental predicate after 'стать', and 'после бега' is genitive of time.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Дыхание' is the neuter nominative subject of 'помогает'. 'Глубокое' is the agreeing neuter adjective, and 'расслабиться' is the infinitive.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural. 'Дыхания' is the inanimate neuter accusative plural object of 'показал'. 'Разные' agrees in the plural, and 'спортсменам' is dative.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Дыхание' is the nominative subject of 'успокаивало', which agrees in the neuter. 'Ровное' is the agreeing neuter adjective.
